name: pdf-forms
description: Inspect and fill PDF forms, find signature locations, add a visible signature stamp with your confirmation, and flatten the result. Documents are processed on a server for each request, not stored by PDF Tools.

interface.longDescription: Inspect fillable PDF fields, fill them with information you provide, find signature locations, add a visible typed signature stamp with your explicit confirmation, and flatten a finished form. PDF Forms uses Open Document Alliance's hosted PDF Tools service. Each request supplies its own PDF by HTTPS URL or inline PDF data; PDF Tools does not store documents. Your assistant host's data terms still apply. Inline PDFs are limited to 3 MB, PDFs fetched by URL to 25 MB, and documents to 200 pages. Returned PDFs are inline data and are also subject to host transfer limits. Encrypted PDFs are refused. A visible stamp is not a cryptographic signature. This hosted edition does not provide the desktop viewer, local folder access, verified extraction workspace, saved profiles, or Lumin signing. It does not establish that a form is complete or ready to submit.
defaultPrompt: List the fillable fields in this PDF.
Fill this PDF form with the values I provide.
Find the signature locations in this PDF.

publication.release_notes: First hosted PDF Forms package. Connects to the existing five-tool PDF Tools HTTPS endpoint. The full local PDF Tools plugin remains separate.
